epsg

Source: R/data.R
epsg.Rd

epsg

Usage

epsg

Format

A data frame containing the European Petroleum Survey Group (EPSG) geodetic parameter dataset as distributed with PROJ.4 software (previously supplied by rgdal). Equivalent Proj4 strings as well as other information on coordinate systems can be found at https://spatialreference.org.

epsg

#> 2      2001
#> 3      2002
#> 4      2003
